<thought>To find a single-step retrosynthetic transformation, I will search the template catalog for reactions whose forward direction creates a ketone and a C‑C triple bond (these will be the groups that appear in the precursors in the retrosynthetic direction). The forward reaction also forms a new C‑C bond and breaks a C‑O bond, matching the description. I will query the database using these functional‑group criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "COC(C1(C=C1[Si](C)(C)C)/C=C/C2=CC=CC=C2)=O",
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones", "C-C triple bonds"],
  "functional_groups_broken": null,
  "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
  "bonds_broken": ["6-8"],
  "limit": 5
}</action_input>
